title: 2026 MLB Draft Class
methodology: Initial neutral Pipeline order uses 70% DD domestic class position and 30% imported BA FYPD rank on a logarithmic rank scale. Missing DD is censored at 99, missing BA at 101. Lowest score ranks first. DD class positions are derived from the October overall list, not personal preferences. The earlier DD pre-draft Top 50 is historical context only. Current Pipeline rank equals this public-input baseline in this initial edition; small pro samples do not automatically reorder players. Consensus is this computed two-input model, not a claim of market-wide consensus. Players without either source rank remain unranked. Actual league FYPD picks are unavailable and stay null.
